title: stage_done.v1
description: The record that a stage without a closing checkpoint was finished once: its gates passed. One YAML file in the approvals directory, written by the agent, no person needed. From then on the stage is enforced: a change that breaks its work fails CI. It never goes outdated; it says the stage was finished once.

stage.description: The stage's id in agent/stages.yaml, e.g. unit_tests.

date.description: When the record was written: ISO 8601 with an offset.

commit.description: The product's commit the stage's gates passed on.
